lightwave_auth_method.title: Lightwave Smart Configuration
lightwave_auth_method.description:
{discovered_hub}Choose your authentication method.

**Account Linking** (recommended) signs in directly on Lightwave via your browser without entering your password in Home Assistant.
**Refresh Token** signs in with your Lightwave email and password once without storing your password.

data_description.instance_name: Optional, your username will be used if not provided

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Lightwave Smart - Password Authentication Configuration

oauth_auth_method.title: Lightwave Smart - Account Linking Configuration
oauth_auth_method.description: {discovered_hub}You will be redirected to Lightwave to authorize the integration. Once authorized, you will be redirected back to Home Assistant to complete the setup.
